speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I walked out between the degrees. Indoors, every hour is night. The vault did not need a dusk, and I did not give it one.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The Nurse did what my lord said a nurse would do. I am not repeating his sentence where a yeoman can eat it. She did the thing. That is the report.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I did not look away. He held to the dagger. He stayed under every note. Grave, and low. A whisper in there is a speech, and he did not spend one by accident.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: It held. I am not spending him on a song because a chair was kind. Gladness can wait. The note can wait.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There was no hush like the Theatre's. A rustle. One cough. Then the chair rose. That is the end it had, and I am not improving the end.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Half an hour. The length of the stage-front, and under the trestles. I had the candle low. It is not there. I would have felt a hard thing among the rushes, and I felt rushes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A gold button, five pearls in it, gone from the kirtle since we began. I did not find it. I am not the man who is going to.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A little gold thing may raise a bigger search than a missing player ever did.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Keep that. Not at this supper, and not at the Feathers. Until the inn, when we are down the river. Until then it is not a story, Will, and I will hear if you make it one.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Until the inn. I can hold a thing that long. I held three lines last night, and a hand, and I am not telling those to a yeoman either.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Five pearls is a number. Write it nowhere tonight. A lost button is the palace's loss. It is not a line in our book, and it is not a share.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can look again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast looked for half an hour. Nobody is going to find it. Leave the rushes as rushes. A second search is how a boy becomes the owner of a thing he does not have.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Come away from the floor, Sam. The scarlet at the edge of thy candle is a yeoman's, and a yeoman is not thy confessor.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Count the note as held, and then stop counting it. A second praise will only teach him to spend it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I did the Nurse. I did not decorate my lord's old sentence. If a man wants that sentence, he may ask my lord. He may not ask me in a passage.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And nobody picks a glint out of the dark to shorten the search. There was no glint. The boy has said rushes. I believe the rushes.

speaker: will_kemp
text: No glint. I can hold that with the rest. A story that glints is a story that found the thing, and we did not find the thing.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I would have brought it if my hand had closed on it. My hand closed on rosemary. Rosemary is not five pearls.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Rosemary is the floor. Five is the number of the pearls, and the number stays in the air. It does not go into a purse, and it does not go into my hand.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The boy on the floor is done. The boy with the dagger is done. I looked at the second the whole night. I am not starting on the first.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then both boys are accounted. The note stays where it was put.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Heads in the morning, at a door, and no reckoning tonight. God keep you.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Until the inn, then. Not a word of it over the Feathers' supper, and not a word of it to the scarlet at the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. We are still in the hall. The bed is the other side of a walk I am not taking in this breath. The button stays lost.
